PressRelease.description: Press release record described by the API field dictionary.

info.description: Searches the Chief Secretary for Administration press releases. The API documentation does not specify an API version; “undocumented” is a metadata placeholder, not a publisher API version. Authentication requirements are not documented.
info.title: Chief Secretary for Administration - Press Releases

get.description: Returns press releases in the requested language. At most 400 records are returned. The documented example uses lang=en; the catalog also lists Simplified Chinese (sc) and Traditional Chinese (tc) API resources, but the API document does not enumerate accepted language values.

parameters.description: Language selection. The documented English request uses en. Catalogued API resources also use sc and tc.
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Optional inclusive start date in YYYYMMDD format. Must be used together with end. The accepted start date is limited to the last six months, in HKT (GMT+8).
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Optional inclusive end date in YYYYMMDD format. Must be used together with start. The accepted end date is today, in HKT (GMT+8).
parameters.name: end

schema.description: Object/results envelope observed in one source-backed saved response. Additional properties remain allowed; no universal envelope requiredness is inferred.

results.description: Documented record fields in the observed results array. Saved response has no records, so item shape was not exercised.

returned-count.description: Observed envelope key; universal type and requiredness are not specified by the publisher dictionary.

total-count.description: Observed envelope key; universal type and requiredness are not specified by the publisher dictionary.

200.description: Successful search. The documentation describes the returned API records and their fields, but does not specify an outer response envelope or provide response-status/error schemas. Outer object/results envelope is corroborated by one saved source-backed query, rather than specified by the field dictionary.
